# Verglas

> Verglas is the trust layer for agent money on Avalanche: a rule-bound,
> non-custodial vault for AI agents, zero-knowledge proofs that a whole
> spending window obeyed the owner's rules, and attestations that travel to
> every Avalanche L1 over native Interchain Messaging (ICM). Live on Fuji
> testnet with the canonical ERC-8004 registries and real Circle USDC.

Key facts:
- Category: AI-agent trust & treasury infrastructure on Avalanche (C-Chain + sovereign L1s)
- The vault (VerglasAccount): whitelist, per-transaction limit, lifetime budget and an owner freeze — the rule engine lives in the contract, and every spend folds into a Poseidon hash chain
- The receipt: a Groth16 zk-SNARK (~86k constraints) proves every payment obeyed the rules without revealing a single transaction; verified on-chain for ~287k gas
- The stamp: Verglas wrote the first ZK-verified validation response on the canonical ERC-8004 Validation Registry on Avalanche Fuji
- The passport: attestations cross to any Avalanche L1 over ICM; the receiving gate answers one view call — isCleared(agentId)
- Agent identities are real ERC-721 tokens on the canonical ERC-8004 Identity Registry (live agents #219 and #220)
- Verglas Treasurer (first vertical): an autonomous corporate treasury agent that pays FX-timed supplier invoices inside a daily cap and a USD/TRY circuit breaker, backtested at 3.79% savings over 254 days of real USD/TRY data
- Owner console at /app: live vault status, the freeze lever, policy editing, proof receipts and the interchain passport; installable as a PWA
- Positioning: open standard (ERC-8004) + real on-chain proofs + trust that travels — not a walled platform score
